# init requires slug and forge-ref

kc init requires the --slug and --forge-ref options (both are marked required); the command will fail if either is omitted.

Ensure a repository is registered with a unique slug and a forge reference so it can be inserted into the knowledge base and kc.toml can be written.

- `knowledge_compiler/cli.py` — `knowledge_compiler.cli.init_cmd`
